cohort: 911 pregnant women who underwent ECV at 'Virgen de la Arrixaca' Clinic University Hospital (Murcia, Spain) between January 2014 and December 2023
finding: ECV is a safe and effective option for women with a previous cesarean section, with success rates comparable to those without a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: Of the women who attempted a vaginal delivery after ECV, 80.8% were successful.
